query: WITH features AS (SELECT a.id, a.title, a.url, a.outlet, a.feed, COALESCE(a.ingestion_run_id, 'untagged') AS ingestion_run_id, a.published_at, a.claims, COALESCE(jsonb_array_length(a.claims), 0) AS claim_count, COALESCE(bool_or(c.id IS NOT NULL), false) AS has_citation, COALESCE(array_agg(DISTINCT c.cited_type) FILTER (WHERE c.id IS NOT NULL), ARRAY[]::text[]) AS citation_types, COALESCE(bool_or((item->>'kind') = 'substantive'), false) AS has_substantive, COALESCE(bool_or((item->>'kind') = 'framing'), false) AS has_framing FROM public.articles a LEFT JOIN public.citations c ON c.article_id = a.id LEFT JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(a.claims, '[]'::jsonb)) AS item ON true GROUP BY a.id, a.title, a.url, a.outlet, a.feed, a.ingestion_run_id, a.published_at, a.claims), classified AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN has_substantive AND has_framing AND has_citation THEN 'fully_extracted' WHEN has_substantive OR has_framing OR has_citation THEN 'partially_extracted' ELSE 'extraction_absent' END AS extraction_class FROM features), ranked_absent AS (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY ingestion_run_id ORDER BY published_at DESC NULLS LAST, id) AS run_rank, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY outlet ORDER BY published_at DESC NULLS LAST, id) AS outlet_rank FROM classified WHERE extraction_class = 'extraction_absent') SELECT extraction_class, id, title, outlet, feed, ingestion_run_id, published_at, claim_count, has_substantive, has_framing, has_citation, citation_types, claims FROM classified WHERE extraction_class = 'partially_extracted' UNION ALL SELECT extraction_class, id, title, outlet, feed, ingestion_run_id, published_at, claim_count, has_substantive, has_framing, has_citation, citation_types, claims FROM ranked_absent WHERE (run_rank = 1 OR outlet_rank = 1) AND outlet IN ('Al Jazeera','BBC','South China Morning Post','Fox News','New York Times','Times of India','The Guardian','NPR','U.S. Department of Justice','Associated Press') ORDER BY extraction_class, published_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 40;
